verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents its own batch-style processing: workflows run documents from source connectors such as Azure Blob Storage to destinations, and job APIs let you trigger runs, monitor status and inspect failed files. That supports pushing large batches, but nothing in the evidence documents rate limits, throughput figures or performance at millions-of-pages scale. missing for 10: documented API rate limits/quotas, published throughput or latency guarantees, evidence of million-page-scale batch runs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I push high-volume batches — millions of pages — with documented rate limits and predictable throughput

citations.quote: Create, update, run, and delete workflows that process and transform documents from source to destination.
Trigger runs, monitor status, download results, and inspect any files that failed during processing.
Ingest your files into Unstructured from Azure Blob Storage.
The sample scripts also handle multiple files in a directory
